name: bottom-bar-output-checklist
description: Artifact-level validation checklist for generated New Zhanle AI bottom bars.

checks.question: Does the artifact declare the correct bottom-bar variant for the page context?
checks.evidenceRequired: variant value: primaryPage, chatPage, or stockQuotePage, plus matching page context evidence.
checks.fixIfFail: Reclassify the page context, apply the correct bottom-bar variant, and update the rendered structure and declared variant.

checks.question: Does the bottom bar use the approved background/shadow asset for the declared variant and mode?
checks.evidenceRequired: Mode-matched asset path from assets/bottom-bar/backgrounds rendered in the artifact.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the approved bottom-bar asset and mode-specific binding from references/components-bottom-bar.md and assets/templates/bottom-bar-component.json.

checks.question: Are light and dark bottom-bar assets kept mode-specific without cross-mode mixing?
checks.evidenceRequired: Light mode uses *-light assets and dark mode uses *-dark assets for bottom-bar backgrounds and state icons.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the approved bottom-bar asset and mode-specific binding from references/components-bottom-bar.md and assets/templates/bottom-bar-component.json.

checks.question: Does the artifact apply the declared variant's body, shadow, input, safe-area, and optional row heights?
checks.evidenceRequired: Measurement, style, Figma layer, DOM, or template binding evidence for the metrics in bottom-bar-component.json.
checks.fixIfFail: Reclassify the page context, apply the correct bottom-bar variant, and update the rendered structure and declared variant.

checks.question: Does the bottom bar include the 34px iOS safe-area extension below the business controls?
checks.evidenceRequired: Named safeArea node or measured bottom extension reaching the frame bottom without business controls.
checks.fixIfFail: Place the bottom bar flush to the frame bottom and keep the 34px safe area inside the component below business controls.

checks.question: Does content preserve 20px spacing to the bottom-bar body, excluding shadow?
checks.evidenceRequired: Layout or measurement evidence showing content gap to body top; shadow overlap is excluded.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Does input text use the correct mode-specific bottom-bar typography and tokens?
checks.evidenceRequired: Voice default: PingFang SC Medium 16px, 按住说话, xzl/color/primary/dark-blue. Text default: PingFang SC Regular 16px, 提问或搜索, xzl/color/text/quaternary resolving to dark #FFFFFF 30%; entered text uses xzl/color/text/primary.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the bottom-bar typography rules and global financial numeric font rules, then verify rendered text runs.

checks.question: Is voice or text input mode declared and reflected by the correct icon asset?
checks.evidenceRequired: inputMode value plus mode-matched voice/keyboard asset path and rendered node.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Are scene-entry default and selected states represented by approved assets?
checks.evidenceRequired: selectedSceneEntry state when applicable and rendered bottom-bar-entry asset paths.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: If thinking mode appears, is selected/unselected state explicit?
checks.evidenceRequired: thinkingMode state plus visible selected-state evidence for the chip/icon.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: On stock quote pages, do buy/sell/cancel use bottom-bar round assets instead of ordinary CTA buttons?
checks.evidenceRequired: quoteActions structure with buy/sell/cancel asset paths and 48x48 rendered/hit metrics.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the approved bottom-bar asset and mode-specific binding from references/components-bottom-bar.md and assets/templates/bottom-bar-component.json.

checks.question: Do all bottom-bar icons use approved PNG/SVG assets rather than hand-drawn approximations?
checks.evidenceRequired: Asset paths, component bindings, or rendered nodes for entry, mode, pause, agent, and quote action icons.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the approved bottom-bar asset and mode-specific binding from references/components-bottom-bar.md and assets/templates/bottom-bar-component.json.

checks.question: Do icons and hit areas match the approved bottom-bar metrics?
checks.evidenceRequired: Measurements for 48x48 scene-entry layout/hit boxes, 86x86 selected visual bounds anchored to the 48x48 center, 48x48 quote actions, 30x30 mode toggle, 13x16 voice icon, pause metrics, 14x14 agent/right-expand, and 18x18 up/down icons.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Are required bottom-bar icons visibly rendered in the final artifact?
checks.evidenceRequired: Visible rendered SVG/path/image geometry, screenshot evidence, or non-zero visible pixel/bounding-box proof.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: If quote info values appear, do financial numeric runs use 涨乐财富体?
checks.evidenceRequired: Text-run evidence for quote prices, amounts, or percentages using the bundled financial numeric font.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the bottom-bar typography rules and global financial numeric font rules, then verify rendered text runs.

checks.question: On primaryPage, is 交易入口 rendered as a scene entry with entry-trade assets instead of quote action assets?
checks.evidenceRequired: primaryPage variant plus bottom-bar-entry-trade-* asset paths; evidence that bottom-bar-action-buy/sell/cancel assets are not used for the trade entry.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the approved bottom-bar asset and mode-specific binding from references/components-bottom-bar.md and assets/templates/bottom-bar-component.json.

checks.question: Are buy/sell/cancel quoteActions used only in stockQuotePage or an explicit quote-detail bottom action bar context?
checks.evidenceRequired: stockQuotePage variant or explicit quote-detail context before any quoteActions; no quoteActions in primaryPage sceneEntries.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Is paperTrade shown only when explicitly required by context or user request?
checks.evidenceRequired: Rendered scene entry list and rationale for paperTrade; notApplicable when 模拟交易 is not requested or not part of page context.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Do selected scene entries use 86x86 visual bounds while retaining a 48x48 layout box and hit area?
checks.evidenceRequired: Measurement or structure evidence distinguishing selected visual bounds from layout box and hit area.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Is the selected 86x86 visual anchored to the center of the 48x48 scene-entry layout box without moving the entry position?
checks.evidenceRequired: Center-point, Figma constraint, DOM geometry, or structure evidence showing the entry center and spacing remain stable across default/selected states.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Do default scene entries show icon-only labels unless text-label entry assets are explicitly requested?
checks.evidenceRequired: Default scene-entry asset paths use icon-default assets, or explicit requirement for text-default assets.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Does the primaryPage bottom-bar input pill use 48px height and 999px radius?
checks.evidenceRequired: Style, Figma measurement, DOM geometry, or template binding evidence for 48px height and 999px radius.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Does the input pill use the approved material for light mode and dark voice mode instead of only replacing text?
checks.evidenceRequired: Light material #FFFFFF 60% -> #FFFFFF 90% with 0.6px #CDDCF5 border; dark voice includes the three approved gradient layers, #FFFFFF 80% -> #FFFFFF 29% border, and 0 0 4px rgba(62,65,122,0.24) inset shadow.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Does dark text-input mode use the approved quiet translucent material distinct from dark voice mode?
checks.evidenceRequired: Dark text input background #FFFFFF 8% and border #FFFFFF 8% -> #FFFFFF 3%; evidence that the dark voice gradient material is not used for text/default.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.question: Does the input-mode toggle icon represent the next available input mode?
checks.evidenceRequired: inputMode: text shows the voice toggle asset bottom-bar-mode-voice-light.svg or bottom-bar-mode-voice-dark.svg; inputMode: voice shows the keyboard toggle asset bottom-bar-mode-keyboard-light.svg or bottom-bar-mode-keyboard-dark.svg. Evidence includes props/layers/DOM and rendered asset path.
checks.fixIfFail: Bind inputModeToggle by next available mode: text -> voice asset, voice -> keyboard asset.

checks.question: Is inputModeToggle asset binding based on the next available input mode rather than the current mode?
checks.evidenceRequired: Current inputMode text with 提问或搜索 uses bottom-bar-mode-voice-light.svg or bottom-bar-mode-voice-dark.svg. Current inputMode voice with 按住说话 uses bottom-bar-mode-keyboard-light.svg or bottom-bar-mode-keyboard-dark.svg. Dark text/default must not use bottom-bar-mode-keyboard-dark.svg.
checks.fixIfFail: Rebind inputModeToggle: text -> voice asset, voice -> keyboard asset; do not bind keyboard asset to text/default state.

checks.question: Do input-mode toggle assets match light/dark mode and render at 30x30 in dark mode?
checks.evidenceRequired: For the mapped next-mode asset, light uses *-light.svg and dark uses *-dark.svg; dark text/default uses bottom-bar-mode-voice-dark.svg at 30x30, not bottom-bar-mode-keyboard-dark.svg.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the mode-matched asset from assetWhenCurrentModeIsText/Voice and keep dark toggle size 30x30.

checks.question: Does text/default input use PingFang SC Regular 16px and xzl/color/text/quaternary, not Medium 500?
checks.evidenceRequired: Text default placeholder 提问或搜索 uses Regular 400, 16px, xzl/color/text/quaternary; dark mode resolves to #FFFFFF 30%.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the bottom-bar typography rules and global financial numeric font rules, then verify rendered text runs.

checks.question: Is voice/default input content centered as a combined voice-icon plus 按住说话 text group?
checks.evidenceRequired: Layout evidence showing the 13x16 voice icon and text group centered inside the pill, not only text-align on the label.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the relevant bottom-bar reference rule, revise the artifact, and provide concrete DOM/Figma/measurement evidence for this check.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: bottom bar contains inputPill and inputMode is voice
checks.question: Is the voice icon plus 按住说话 text centered as one combined group against the full inputPill bounds?
checks.evidenceRequired: Measurement or DOM/Figma evidence showing the combined voice icon + text group center equals the full inputPill center; inputModeToggle is excluded from the centering calculation.
checks.fixIfFail: Center the combined voice content group against the full inputPill and avoid shrinking the content area or using asymmetric padding to compensate for inputModeToggle.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: bottom bar contains inputPill and inputMode is text
checks.question: Does the text input placeholder 提问或搜索 start 16px from the inputPill left edge?
checks.evidenceRequired: Measurement or DOM/Figma evidence showing placeholder left edge is 16px from the inputPill left edge; right-side toggle reserve space does not alter this left inset.
checks.fixIfFail: Set text input placeholder left inset to 16px and constrain overflow on the right side without changing the left start position.

checks.question: Does 首页 primaryPage use the approved horizontal layout with trade on the left, adaptive input in the center, and watchHold on the right?
checks.evidenceRequired: 390x130 frame; body bottom 34px height 48px; trade x=16 size 48x48; watchHold right=21 size 48x48; input auto width between entries; 16px gaps on both sides of input; for 390px frame input width resolves to 225px.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the primaryPage horizontal layout contract instead of approximate spacing or grouping entries after the input.

checks.question: Are trade and watchHold placed around the input instead of grouped after the input?
checks.evidenceRequired: DOM/Figma/layer order or measured x positions showing trade / input / watchHold.
checks.fixIfFail: Move trade to the left of input and watchHold to the right of input.

checks.question: For standalone bottom-bar prototypes, are input mode and scene-entry selected states clickable when relevant assets exist?
checks.evidenceRequired: Clicking inputModeToggle changes inputMode and mode toggle asset; clicking sceneEntry changes selectedSceneEntry and uses approved active/default assets.
checks.fixIfFail: Add prototype interaction handlers and bind state to approved mode and entry assets.

checks.question: Does a component prototype lead with the bottom-bar component itself rather than large fake page content or checklist panels?
checks.evidenceRequired: The component frame is the primary visible output; optional phone preview and checklist are secondary.
checks.fixIfFail: Move explanatory content below and remove unnecessary fake page modules or measurement markers.

checks.question: When stockQuotePage includes indexInfo, does it use the one-line index information structure?
checks.evidenceRequired: One-line structure: 指数名称 + 点位 + 涨跌额 + 涨跌幅 + 展开/收起箭头. No 上证指数 / 深证成指 two-column card.
checks.fixIfFail: Remove the two-column index card and render the one-line index information structure.

checks.question: When stockQuotePage includes indexInfo, do the index name, numbers, and arrow use the approved typography, size, and color?
checks.evidenceRequired: Index name: PingFang SC Regular 400, 13px, xzl/color/text/primary. Values: ZLCaiFuTi Regular 13px with red-up/green-down tokens. Arrow: shared xzl-arrow-up/down component-library shape, 18x18, xzl/color/text/tertiary resolving to light #6D778B and dark 50% #FFFFFF.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply stock quote index typography and financial red/green semantics.

checks.question: When stockQuotePage includes indexInfo, do the index row, divider, and operation spacing match the indexInfo reference?
checks.evidenceRequired: Index left/right 18px; number-arrow gap 12px; top-to-index 7px; index-to-divider 7px; divider-to-actions 15px; full-width 0.5px divider using xzl/color/input/background.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the index row spacing contract and full-width divider.

checks.question: When stockQuotePage includes indexInfo, are controls directly above the 34px safe area with no extra internal blank space?
checks.evidenceRequired: Box model shows business content height equals declared rows/gaps/divider/action height; bottom-bar container bottom is 0; safeArea is 34px inside the container and contains no business controls.
checks.fixIfFail: Remove undeclared internal blank space and keep only the 34px safe area below the operation layer.

checks.question: When stockQuotePage includes indexInfo, does the bottom bar use the approved index-info background material?
checks.evidenceRequired: Layered structure: independent 179px backgroundAsset/shadow layer below quotePanel and unclipped; quotePanel has radius 20px 20px 0 0. Light panel uses 190deg white gradient, 0 0 20px rgba(107,186,240,0.25), blur(15px), two independent blurred shape layers, and independent 0.5px 190deg gradient stroke. Dark panel uses Figma Inspect background layers linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(36,54,103,0.40) -7.33%, rgba(18,26,54,0.01) 52.57%) plus #051027, with independent 180deg transparent white gradient stroke.
checks.fixIfFail: Separate the background/shadow layer from quotePanel, keep shadow unclipped, and apply mode-correct panel material/stroke.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: stockQuotePage includes quoteInfoRow or indexInfo in light mode
checks.question: Does the light quotePanel render the two approved blurred shape layers as separate layers?
checks.evidenceRequired: Shape 1 is 218x106 #758AA0 opacity 0.5 blur 100; shape 2 is 259.854x106 #BACCDF opacity 0.4 blur 60; both are inside quotePanel, below content and stroke. Figma uses independent shape nodes; HTML uses independent DOM layers such as .light-blob.one and .light-blob.two.
checks.fixIfFail: Create two independent blurred shape layers and remove radial-gradient, merged glow, box-shadow, or ordinary background approximations.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: stockQuotePage includes quoteInfoRow or indexInfo in light mode
checks.question: Does the light quotePanel avoid radial-gradient or single-background approximations for the two glows?
checks.evidenceRequired: No radial-gradient or merged background is used to represent the two approved blur shapes; separate nodes/layers are inspectable.
checks.fixIfFail: Replace radial-gradient or merged background approximations with the two approved independent blur layers.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: stockQuotePage includes quoteInfoRow or indexInfo in dark mode
checks.question: Does the dark quotePanel use the approved Figma Inspect background material?
checks.evidenceRequired: Dark quotePanel background is linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(36,54,103,0.40) -7.33%, rgba(18,26,54,0.01) 52.57%) over #051027, with radius 20px 20px 0 0.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved dark background layers; do not approximate with a flat color, light material, or white panel.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: stockQuotePage includes quoteInfoRow or indexInfo in dark mode
checks.question: Is the dark quotePanel stroke an independent transparent white gradient instead of a solid white border?
checks.evidenceRequired: Stroke is independent linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.10), rgba(255,255,255,0)); it does not cover or replace the #051027 panel background.
checks.fixIfFail: Replace solid white borders or white overlay mistakes with the approved independent gradient stroke.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: stockQuotePage includes quoteInfoRow or indexInfo collapsed state
checks.question: Does the collapsed indexInfo state use the up arrow when tapping expands upward?
checks.evidenceRequired: Collapsed indexInfo state references assets/icons/xzl-arrow-up.svg; direction is chosen by next motion upward, not by a generic collapsed/down convention.
checks.fixIfFail: Use xzl-arrow-up.svg for the collapsed upward-expand stockQuote indexInfo state.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: standalone HTML/file:// stockQuote indexInfo bottom-bar prototype
checks.question: Does the HTML prototype render the indexInfo arrow with inline approved SVG path, currentColor, and asset trace?
checks.evidenceRequired: Arrow inline SVG path is copied from assets/icons/xzl-arrow-up.svg or xzl-arrow-down.svg, uses fill/stroke currentColor, wrapper uses var(--xzl-color-text-tertiary), and markup keeps asset trace such as data-asset. It does not rely on external <use> for file:// rendering.
checks.fixIfFail: Inline the approved SVG path with currentColor and an asset trace; avoid external-use-only rendering for file:// prototypes.

checks.question: Is the stockQuote indexInfo shadow/background asset free from top rounded-corner clipping?
checks.evidenceRequired: backgroundAsset/shadow layer is independent from quotePanel; outer container does not use overflow:hidden plus border-radius that clips the shadow top.
checks.fixIfFail: Split shadow/background layer from quotePanel and apply top radius only to quotePanel.

checks.question: Is the top radius applied only to quotePanel/body panel?
checks.evidenceRequired: quotePanel has 20px 20px 0 0 radius; shadow/background asset is not rounded or clipped.
checks.fixIfFail: Remove rounded clipping from the shadow/background layer and keep radius on quotePanel only.

checks.question: Are light/dark quotePanel stroke directions correct?
checks.evidenceRequired: Light stroke uses an independent 0.5px gradient stroke with 190deg direction; dark stroke uses independent top-to-bottom #FFFFFF 10% -> #FFFFFF 0% gradient stroke.
checks.fixIfFail: Replace plain border with an independent stroke layer and correct the mode-specific stroke direction.

checks.question: Does the expand/collapse arrow use the component-library arrow asset and bind to text-d?
checks.evidenceRequired: Uses assets/icons/xzl-arrow-up.svg for the collapsed indexInfo state that expands upward, or assets/icons/xzl-arrow-down.svg for expanded state collapse; color is bound to xzl/color/text/tertiary; light resolves #6D778B and dark resolves 50% #FFFFFF.
checks.fixIfFail: Use the shared component-library arrow shape with currentColor/token binding; collapsed upward-expand stockQuote indexInfo uses xzl-arrow-up.svg, not down.

checks.question: Is the expand/collapse arrow rendered at 18x18?
checks.evidenceRequired: Rendered icon visual size is 18x18, matching bottom-bar-component.json iconMetrics.upDownExpand.visualSize.
checks.fixIfFail: Change the stockQuote indexInfo arrow from 13x13 to 18x18.

checks.question: Do critical icons avoid CSS-mask-only rendering?
checks.evidenceRequired: Expand/collapse arrow and other P1 icons render through inline approved SVG path plus currentColor token binding with asset trace, or through a visible copied asset; they are not mask-only or external-use-only in file:// prototypes.
checks.fixIfFail: Use inline component-library SVG path plus currentColor token binding and asset trace, or a visible copied asset instead of mask-only/external-use-only rendering.

checks.question: Does chatPage use the approved horizontal layout with trade on the left, adaptive input in the center, and watchHold on the right?
checks.evidenceRequired: Horizontal model left 16 + trade 48 + gap 16 + input auto + gap 16 + watchHold 48 + right 21; input resolves to 225px in a 390px frame; inputModeToggle/pause stay inside the input pill.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the chatPage horizontal layout contract and move inputModeToggle/pause inside the input pill.

checks.question: Does chatPage place the input row above the agent row?
checks.evidenceRequired: 390x171 frame, body 89px, safe area 34px, input row 48px above agent row 26px, with 15px gap from input row to agent row.
checks.fixIfFail: Place input row above the agent row and preserve the chatPage row heights.

checks.question: Do agent chips use the approved capsule material?
checks.evidenceRequired: Background #799FFF 10%; default state has no border.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved agent chip background and remove default borders.

checks.question: chatPage 的 agent row 在 chips 总宽度小于可视宽度时是否整体居中？
checks.evidenceRequired: 390px frame 内 agent row 内容组中心与 frame 中心对齐；或 Figma/DOM/CSS 证明使用居中布局。仅在内容超宽时允许横向滚动或裁切策略。
checks.fixIfFail: 将 agent row 内容组改为居中布局；仅在内容超宽时允许横向滚动。

checks.question: 普通 agent chip 图标是否与文字同色，并按 light/dark 绑定正确模式色？
checks.evidenceRequired: Light 图标/文字为 #2D3A67，Dark 图标/文字为 #B2CFFF；HTML 原型中 currentColor SVG 不得仅通过 引入，并保留 asset trace。
checks.fixIfFail: 使用 inline SVG、symbol/use + currentColor，或可验证的 token-color binding，并保留 asset trace。

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: chatPage includes 任务助手 chip
checks.question: 任务助手右箭头是否使用 shared arrow 资产并绑定 agent chip 当前模式色？
checks.evidenceRequired: 使用 assets/icons/xzl-right-outlined.svg 的原始形状/路径；尺寸 14x14；Light 为 #2D3A67，Dark 为 #B2CFFF；HTML 中不是固定白色 。
checks.fixIfFail: 改为 inline approved SVG path + currentColor，并保留 data-asset。

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: chatPage includes 深度思考 chip in unselected state
checks.question: 深度思考未选中态图标是否按模式绑定颜色？
checks.evidenceRequired: unselected 使用 bottom-bar-agent-deep-thinking.svg 原始形状；Light 为 #2D3A67，Dark 为 #B2CFFF；HTML 原型通过 currentColor 等方式绑定，而不是 img-only。
checks.fixIfFail: 未选中态改为 currentColor 渲染，不要直接 引入 currentColor SVG。

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: chatPage includes 深度思考 chip
checks.question: 深度思考 selected/unselected 图标是否互斥显示？
checks.evidenceRequired: selected 时只显示 selected asset；unselected 时只显示 unselected asset；CSS/Figma variant/DOM 状态可证明两者不会同时渲染可见。
checks.fixIfFail: 增加互斥状态、variant 条件或高优先级显隐规则，避免默认 icon display 规则覆盖隐藏规则。

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: standalone HTML/file:// prototype uses mode-colored SVG icons
checks.question: 需要继承模式色的 currentColor SVG 是否避免仅用 引入？
checks.evidenceRequired: HTML 原型中需要模式变色的 SVG 使用 inline/currentColor/symbol/use 或可验证 token binding；固定色 仅用于模式色已完全正确的资源；inline SVG 保留原始 asset trace。
checks.fixIfFail: 替换为可继承颜色的渲染方式，并保留原始 asset trace。

checks.question: Do agent chips use the approved typography, padding, icon size, and icon-text spacing?
checks.evidenceRequired: PingFang SC Regular 12px; padding left/right 12px and top/bottom 4px; SVG icon renders 14x14; icon-text gap 2px.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the approved agent chip typography and spacing metrics.

checks.question: Do agent chip text and icons use the approved light/dark colors?
checks.evidenceRequired: Light text/icon color #2D3A67; dark text/icon color #B2CFFF. Ordinary agent SVG icons are color-bound through Figma variables or verifiable HTML currentColor/symbol/use binding; not img-only currentColor inheritance.
checks.fixIfFail: Bind agent text and icons to the approved mode color, using inline SVG/currentColor or another verifiable token binding for HTML prototypes.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: chatPage includes 深度思考 chip
checks.question: Does 深度思考 selected state keep the background, add the approved border, and use the dedicated selected SVG asset?
checks.evidenceRequired: thinkingMode selected/unselected declared; selected background remains #799FFF 10%; selected border 0.5px with light #2D3A67 or dark #B2CFFF; selected icon uses deep-thinking-selected-light.svg or deep-thinking-selected-dark.svg; selected and unselected icons are not both visible.
checks.fixIfFail: Declare thinkingMode and use the dedicated selected SVG instead of generic check assets or hand-drawn icons.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: chatPage includes 任务助手 chip
checks.question: Does 任务助手 chip render agent icon + text + divider + right arrow with approved metrics and colors?
checks.evidenceRequired: Divider 12px high and 0.5px thick; text-divider gap 6px; divider-arrow gap 6px; arrow renders 14x14; light #2D3A67 and dark #B2CFFF colors; arrow uses original shape/path from shared assets/icons/xzl-right-outlined.svg with currentColor/token binding, not fixed-white img rendering.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the task-assistant chip internal structure, divider metrics, and shared icon-library arrow asset.

checks.appliesOnlyWhen: chatPage includes agent chips or standalone HTML bottom-bar prototype
checks.question: Do agent icons, 深度思考 selected icons, and task-assistant arrow use approved direct file/component assets instead of inline SVG, CSS mask, or hand-drawn substitutes?
checks.evidenceRequired: Agent icons use approved assets/bottom-bar/icons/bottom-bar-agent-*.svg shapes with mode color binding; currentColor SVGs that need mode color are not img-only in HTML. 深度思考 selected references deep-thinking-selected-*.svg as file assets; task arrow uses shared assets/icons/xzl-right-outlined.svg shape with token binding. No CSS mask, hand-drawn, emoji, lucide, PNG substitute, or anonymous inline path.
checks.fixIfFail: Replace substitutes with approved file/component assets and relative prototype asset references.
